OpenXR headers for the XR bridge (`../../xrbridge`), from the Khronos OpenXR SDK at tag `release-1.1.63`. OpenXR-SDK-Source (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK-Source/tree/release-1.1.63) commits only `include/openxr/openxr_platform_defines.h` and generates the rest from its registry at build time, so `openxr.h`, `openxr_platform.h` and `openxr_reflection.h` are the copies Khronos publishes from that tag at https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK/tree/release-1.1.63/include/openxr. All four are byte-identical to the headers inside `org.khronos.openxr:openxr_loader_for_android:1.1.63`, the loader `app/build.gradle` links, so bump both together. Apache-2.0 OR MIT; the SDK's `LICENSE` is alongside.
